title: The Timeline revamp PR added IssueBulkUpdateDateEndpoint, which fetches issues by caller-supplied ids without filtering by the URL's workspace and project, so a member of any project can change start/target dates of any issue on the instance.

findings.explanation: The new endpoint uses Django ORM querysets with filter(**filters) and annotations; no raw SQL strings are constructed from user input.

evidence.content:
issue = (
    Issue.issue_objects.filter(
        workspace__slug=slug, project_id=project_id
    )
    .select_related(...)
    .annotate(...)
    ...
)
issue = issue.filter(**filters)

findings.explanation: IssueDetailEndpoint fetches an issue based solely on URL parameters (slug, project_id) after a role check; there is no verification that the requesting user belongs to the workspace or project, potentially allowing IDOR.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an ownership/visibility check after retrieving the workspace/project (e.g., verify request.user is a member of the workspace or has access to the project) before returning the issue data.
